name: Ravi Sharma
bio: I've helped Mumbai families buy, sell and rent homes for over a decade. Most of my clients are first-time buyers and families moving within the western suburbs, so I spend a lot of time explaining society paperwork, home-loan steps and what a fair price really looks like. I live in Bandra West, I pick up my own phone, and I'll tell you honestly when a flat isn't right for you.
tagline: Your neighbour in Mumbai real estate
headline: Family homes, first-time buyers and society resales in Bandra and Khar.

process_steps.title: Understand
process_steps.description: We sit down over chai and talk budget, neighbourhood, schools and commute, so I know what home means for you.

process_steps.title: Shortlist
process_steps.description: I send a short, honest list of flats that fit, with society details and fair-price notes for each.

process_steps.title: Visit
process_steps.description: We see them together on your schedule, evenings and weekends included. I point out what brochures leave out.

process_steps.title: Keys
process_steps.description: I handle negotiation, the agreement, society NOC and registration until the keys are in your hand.
